mapper.select: SELECT holding_id, user_id, etf_id, quantity, average_price, created_at, updated_at FROM holdings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND etf_id = #{etfId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holdings (user_id, etf_id, quantity, average_price) VALUES (#{userId}, #{etfId}, #{quantity}, #{averagePrice})
mapper.select: SELECT h.etf_id, e.etf_code, e.etf_name, h.quantity, h.average_price, e.current_price, (e.current_price * h.quantity) AS eval_amount, ((e.current_price * h.quantity) - (h.average_price * h.quantity)) AS profit_amount, ( CASE WHEN h.average_price > 0 THEN (((e.current_price * h.quantity) - (h.average_price * h.quantity)) * 100.0 / (h.average_price * h.quantity)) ELSE 0 END ) AS profit_rate FROM holdings h INNER JOIN etf_product e ON h.etf_id = e.etf_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC
